children: Halozyme Therapeutics completed a $1.5 billion offering of 1.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2033, receiving approximately $1.471 billion in net proceeds. The notes, convertible at an initial price of about $139.84 per share, provide funding flexibility as the company targets general corporate uses and potential repurchases of its 2027 and 2028 notes. To mitigate dilution risk, Halozyme also entered capped call transactions with an initial cap price of about $208.39 per share, funded with roughly $187.5 million of the proceeds. The combined financing and hedging are designed to support growth while managing future equity dilution.
